name: TVM Manchester Ltd / TVM Sound
notes: TVM Manchester Ltd was incorporated in 1957 and manufactured amplifiers and PA equipment during the 1960s-70s. A surviving TVM Fuzz Box has distinctly 1960s construction features. Exact production date remains unresolved, so preserve the fuzz as a rare period object without invented chronology.

name: EF-EL / Calderoni Musica
dirt_evidence: Vox by EF-EL Distortion; EUR Distortion family
notes: EF-EL (Calderoni Musica) is explicitly identified as the physical producer of rare Italian fuzz/distortion products. Preserve customer brands such as Vox, Goldsound, G.I.S., EUR and Silversound as separate marketed identities linked later through relationships.

name: Roger Mayer
notes: Mayer directly states he designed his first fuzz guitar effects pedal in 1964, and specialist research documents his early custom fuzz work for session players. Early units should be represented as custom-built devices, distinct from his later commercial catalog.

name: Orville 'Red' Rhodes
notes: Rhodes developed a fuzz circuit in California and made multiple small-box units for musicians including Nokie Edwards and Billy Strange. No conventional production line is established, so classify as custom/micro-builder rather than mass manufacturer.

name: Paul Lucas / Tridents
dirt_evidence: Custom fuzz box for Jeff Beck
notes: A strong documented custom-build attribution exists for a Jeff Beck fuzz box, but the surviving evidence currently establishes a single known commission rather than a broader independent pedal-making operation.
